note: Wooded family campground off Haines Hill Road, a short drive from downtown Wolfeboro and Lake Winnipesaukee. Nightly and seasonal sites; no generators. Tent sites were not rented in 2026. --Claude
summary: Operator site + Google: 50 wooded sites, water/sewer/electric, trailers to 32 ft, $45 (2026), 2-night weekend minimum, phone booking with mailed deposit, open Memorial Day to Columbus Day (May 22-Oct 11, 2026), showers/store/WiFi. Google 4.7 (52). Not waterfront. Owner's death noted June 2026; the site says the campground carries on.
flags: Private park: Google Maps 4.7 stars, 52 reviews. $45 a night, one rate all season (cheapest and summer peak both $45), under the $50 gate.

Long-stay tests: pass. The rates page sells RV nights and the 2-night minimum is weekends only; seasonal sites exist ('RESERVE A SEASONAL RV SITE TODAY!'), share not stated; closed canopy hides the sites on imagery. No age rule.
Status: the About Us page (June 18, 2026) records the death of the owner and says the campground's 'legacy will continue'; no 2027 rates or dates are posted yet. Worth a look before the 2027 season.
